source.locator: Official CTA adoption and foundational bootstrap / BOOT-09

scope: current project canonical operations and active runtime adapter/selected prepared credential
verification: Attributable observations or sufficient effective-credential permission inspection through the configured adapter; signing separately where applicable.
unknown: Keep affected read/write readiness unresolved; establish missing facts without claiming success.
failure: Preserve actual effects; repair authorized local defects or explain a genuine human/provider dependency.
recovery: Await actual human attachment/permission change when necessary, inspect resulting access and reverify before readiness.
semantic_clause: | **BOOT-09** | Verify operations access and effective identity before installation. | Verify that <project-root>/operations is the local repository bound to the intended canonical operations. Verify authenticated read and write, and separately required signing only when applicable, using only the project-authorized machine identity credential files physically present in the current project's common private area, shared by all runtimes of the project and selected in BOOT-07, through the SEC-02 controlled envelope. Independently verify effective principal, configuration origin, controlled adapter, authorization/purpose and exact repository/ref. A genuinely credential-free public read cannot satisfy authenticated operations readiness. Reject another, external-store or ambient principal even on successful access. Preserve machine owner_name/owner_email author/committer metadata and independently legitimate signer requirements for any actual later commit. No generic canonical-files commit or preliminary operations push is required to finish technical installation. Do not invent business facts or create test/empty commits. Repair only within authority; otherwise retain a precise blocker. |
